paragraphs: Chattermill’s mission to turn every customer interaction into actionable insight mirrors my recent work building a production RAG and agentic retrieval system for a fintech client, where I deployed a Claude‑powered retrieval pipeline with LangChain, LangGraph and ChromaDB on GCP Cloud Run.

I also engineered a tool‑calling LLM agent for a multi‑omics cancer research platform, integrating LangChain with AWS Bedrock and Claude Haiku 4.5 to resolve gene aliases, explain scoring methods and trace dataset provenance.

During a live stakeholder demo for a Madrid‑based start‑up, I prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, leveraging FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI to showcase real‑time decision support.
Could we schedule a brief call so I can walk you through how these agentic and retrieval workflows could be adapted to analyse Uber and Amazon customer feedback at scale?
